features: 22.5W SUPERFAST CHARGING: Charges your iPhone 15 up to 55% and OnePlus 9R up to 50% in just 30 minutes, making it 2x faster than standard chargers.
TRIPLE OUTPUT WITH PD SUPPORT: Features triple output ports along with Power Delivery (PD) and Programmable Power Supply (PPS) compatibility for versatile, high-speed charging.
QUICK CHARGE COMPATIBLE: Supports Quick Charge technology, ensuring rapid and efficient charging for a wide range of compatible smartphones and devices.
SMART LED DISPLAY: Built-in LED display shows real-time battery percentage, output voltage, and current, so you always know the exact charging power status.
ULTRA SLIM DESIGN & URBN SAFE: Sleek and portable 10,000 mAh power bank with an ultra slim build, backed by URBN Safe protection and a 6-month warranty.
description: The URBN 10,000 mAh Edge Power Bank is your ultimate on-the-go charging companion, engineered to keep all your devices powered up at blazing speeds. With 22.5W superfast charging, it can charge an iPhone 15 to 55% or a OnePlus 9R to 50% in just 30 minutes — that is 2x faster than conventional power banks. The Power Delivery (PD) compatibility, Quick Charge support, and Programmable Power Supply (PPS) technology ensure optimal charging for a wide range of devices. Featuring triple output ports, you can charge multiple devices simultaneously without any hassle. The smart LED display shows real-time charging power status, including voltage and current, so you always know exactly how much power remains. Wrapped in an ultra-slim, textured design, this power bank is easy to carry in your pocket or bag. URBN Safe protection safeguards your devices against overcharging, overheating, and short circuits. Backed by a 6-month warranty, the URBN Edge Power Bank is a reliable and powerful charging solution for everyday use.
